Working knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) and issue-tracking tools, including Remedy, ServiceNow, Cherwell, and Jira.
Capable of managing projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation and delivery.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE SUMMARY

Team Lead with 11.8 years of IT experience in application development, enhancement, maintenance, service delivery.
Designed and developed N-tire web, windows using C#, ASP.NET core, MVC, API, Angular as front end and securing using JWT token and SQL Server.
Good understanding of Architecture concepts like SOLID principles, Design patterns and Microservices.

Proficient in SQL Server, with hands-on experience in developing stored procedures, triggers, and views, executing database backup and recovery, creating scheduled jobs, performing database migrations, and implementing SSIS solutions.
Worked extensively with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Microsoft Power BI (Power BI Desktop) to develop cloud-based integration, data processing, and reporting solutions.
Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and familiar with Kubernetes and Docker.

Experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance, within Agile Scrum environments.
Working knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) and issue-tracking tools, including Remedy, ServiceNow, Cherwell, and Jira.
Capable of managing projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation and delivery.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Microsoft Power Platform: Power Apps, Canvas Apps, Model-driven Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI, Power Platform Connectors, Custom Connectors, PCF
Dataverse / MDP: Dataverse Web API, FetchXML, Data Modeling, Business Rules, Plugins, Queries, Security, Data Validation, Data Migration, Reconciliation
Azure: Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure DevOps, Webhooks, Event-driven Integration, API Integration, Application Workflows
Development: C#, .NET, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, REST APIs, JSON, Web APIs
Data: SQL Server, SQL Queries, SharePoint, Dataverse, Data Transformation, Data Validation, Data Migration, Deduplication, Reconciliation
Reporting: Power BI, Data Modeling, KPI Dashboards, Cost Reporting, Savings Reporting, Completion Metrics, Integration Status

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Manager | Capgemini
December 2024 - September 2025
Client - Mercedes
Led the application maintenance team by coordinating support activities, streamlining maintenance processes, and ensuring smooth application operations.
 Responsible for maintaining applications developed using .NET Core, Angular and SQL Server.
 Worked on change requests and resolved issues related to Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions for
existing applications.
 Developed a mini chatbot project using Angular and OpenAI API technologies to strengthen technical
expertise in building modern AI-powered applications.
Team Lead | Accenture Solutions
September 2021 - June 2023
Client - M&G Investments
 Designed and developed enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate,
Azure services, .NET, REST APIs, and Power BI.
 Developed and maintained Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions to facilitate seamless data
integration between applications.
 Designed and managed Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines to orchestrate and load data products into
Azure SQL Database.
 Designed and developed enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate,
Azure services, .NET, REST APIs, and Power BI.
 Developed Canvas and Model-driven Power Apps to digitize manual business processes and provide
users with centralized, role-based application experiences.
 Designed Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, views, forms, and queries to establish
a consistent source of truth for enterprise data.
 Worked closely with cross-functional teams, contributing ideas and best practices to improve project
execution and delivery.
 Applied strong analytical, troubleshooting and debugging skills to resolve technical challenges and
enhance application performance.
IT Analyst | Tata Consultancy Services
May 2019 - April 2020
Client - SuperValu
 Responsible for maintaining applications developed using ASP.NET MVC and SQL Server.
 Managed database and application code changes, including enhancement requests and maintenance
activities.
 Analysed and resolved application incidents and service requests within defined SLA timelines.

 Managed team activities, tracked issue resolution progress, and ensured timely delivery of support
services.
 Performed Major Incident (MI) management by collaborating with relevant teams to identify root
causes and implement effective solutions.
Senior Project Engineer | Wipro Technologies Ltd
August 2018 - May 2019
Client - StateStreet
 Developed and maintained PDF reporting solutions for applications built using VB.NET and SQL
Server.
Implemented application enhancements and modifications based on change requests.
 Analysed and resolved application issues and service requests within defined SLA timelines.
Supported application maintenance activities to ensure smooth operation and timely delivery of
reporting solutions.
Senior Project Engineer | Wipro Technologies Ltd
September 2015 - July 2018
Client - Ecube
Enhanced and maintained a project management application developed using Classic ASP, ASP.NET, C#, and SQL Server. Performed SQL Server database activities, including developing stored procedures, triggers, database backup and restoration, SQL Agent job creation, and troubleshooting job failures. Supported application server migration activities to ensure smooth transition and minimal service disruption. Integrated Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) authentication with the application to enhance security and user access management. Involved in the complete application development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, design, coding, implementation, testing, and deployment. Prepared and shared Weekly Status Reports (WSR) with management, highlighting project progress, issues, and deliverables.
